articles.title: Letter: The Senior Exercise Class on Sawmill Avenue Needs Attention
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the June meeting.
To the editor: I have lived on Sawmill Avenue for 4 years, and I want to say what a difference the Bellwood Chapel has made.
Please keep the senior exercise class in the budget. Many of us on Sawmill Avenue use it every week. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Janet Orchard, Bellwood
